## What's the problem?

A clear and concise description of the gap or pain point. (e.g. "When I'm comparing two packages, I can't see…")

## What would you like to see?

The behavior or UI you'd like. Mockups, screenshots, or links to similar features elsewhere are very welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why they don't fit.

## Additional context

Anything else — links, related issues, prior discussions.
